summary: Search, step 2 of 4: a search that finds nothing lists titles that can be requested and takes the request on the search page; the hand-off of typed words to the Requests page's composer is removed. One commit, one pass by the search reviewer with the server's request handlers read: lows-only, no high or medium. No session that may not request can reach the lookup or the POST; another member's request is named only from a list the server returned under the admin powers; the POST and every outcome's wording match the server; one request per press; the earlier search rules are untouched. The tree is the builder's without its unfinished error screen. Open lows: Try again gives no feedback while it retries; the page promises a request before it has read whether the server takes requests; the config and the requests list are fetched at every empty answer; arriving matches are not announced; focus falls to the body in three places; a request's late answer after a sign-out or switch reaches the next owner's list; a refusal for requests being off says try again.
